cash_movement_action_direction_check.name: cash_movement_action_direction_check

cash_movement_source_shape_check.name: cash_movement_source_shape_check
cash_movement_source_shape_check.value:
(
        "cash_movement"."action" = 'expense'
        and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is not null
        and "cash_movement"."transfer_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."receivable_payment_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."reversal_of_movement_id" is null
      ) or (
        "cash_movement"."action" in ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out')
        and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."transfer_id" is not null
        and "cash_movement"."receivable_payment_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."reversal_of_movement_id" is null
      ) or (
        "cash_movement"."action" = 'receivable_payment'
        and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."transfer_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."receivable_payment_id" is not null
        and "cash_movement"."reversal_of_movement_id" is null
      ) or (
        "cash_movement"."action" = 'reverse'
        and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."transfer_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."receivable_payment_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."reversal_of_movement_id" is not null
      ) or (
        "cash_movement"."action" in ('opening', 'adjustment_in', 'adjustment_out')
        and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."transfer_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."receivable_payment_id" is null
        and "cash_movement"."reversal_of_movement_id" is null
      )

cash_transfer_note_length_check.name: cash_transfer_note_length_check
cash_transfer_note_length_check.value: "cash_transfer"."note" is null or char_length("cash_transfer"."note") between 1 and 240

expense_payee_length_check.name: expense_payee_length_check
expense_payee_length_check.value: "expense"."payee" is null or char_length("expense"."payee") between 1 and 120

expense_void_shape_check.name: expense_void_shape_check
expense_void_shape_check.value:
(
        "expense"."status" = 'posted'
        and "expense"."voided_at" is null
        and "expense"."voided_by_user_id" is null
        and "expense"."void_reason" is null
      ) or (
        "expense"."status" = 'voided'
        and "expense"."voided_at" is not null
        and "expense"."voided_by_user_id" is not null
        and char_length("expense"."void_reason") between 1 and 240
      )

catalog_operation_target_check.name: catalog_operation_target_check
catalog_operation_target_check.value:
(
        "catalog_operation"."action" like 'category.%'
        and "catalog_operation"."category_id" is not null
        and "catalog_operation"."product_id" is null
        and "catalog_operation"."movement_id" is null
      ) or (
        "catalog_operation"."action" like 'product.%'
        and "catalog_operation"."category_id" is null
        and "catalog_operation"."product_id" is not null
        and "catalog_operation"."movement_id" is null
      ) or (
        "catalog_operation"."action" like 'inventory.%'
        and "catalog_operation"."category_id" is null
        and "catalog_operation"."product_id" is not null
        and "catalog_operation"."movement_id" is not null
      )

catalog_product_sku_check.name: catalog_product_sku_check
catalog_product_sku_check.value: "catalog_product"."sku" is null or (char_length("catalog_product"."sku") between 1 and 64 and btrim("catalog_product"."sku") = "catalog_product"."sku")

catalog_product_price_snapshot_check.name: catalog_product_price_snapshot_check
catalog_product_price_snapshot_check.value:
(
        "catalog_product"."selling_price_minor_units" is null
        and "catalog_product"."selling_price_currency" is null
        and "catalog_product"."selling_price_currency_minor_unit_digits" is null
      ) or (
        "catalog_product"."selling_price_minor_units" >= 0
        and "catalog_product"."selling_price_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
        and "catalog_product"."selling_price_currency_minor_unit_digits" between 0 and 4
      )

inventory_movement_delta_check.name: inventory_movement_delta_check

customer_phone_length_check.name: customer_phone_length_check
customer_phone_length_check.value: "customer"."phone" is null or char_length("customer"."phone") between 1 and 40

customer_email_length_check.name: customer_email_length_check
customer_email_length_check.value: "customer"."email" is null or char_length("customer"."email") between 3 and 254

customer_notes_length_check.name: customer_notes_length_check
customer_notes_length_check.value: "customer"."notes" is null or char_length("customer"."notes") between 1 and 1000

receivable_void_state_check.name: receivable_void_state_check
receivable_void_state_check.value:
(
        "receivable"."status" = 'posted'
        and "receivable"."voided_by_user_id" is null
        and "receivable"."voided_at" is null
        and "receivable"."void_reason" is null
      ) or (
        "receivable"."status" = 'voided'
        and "receivable"."voided_by_user_id" is not null
        and "receivable"."voided_at" is not null
        and char_length("receivable"."void_reason") between 1 and 240
      )

receivable_operation_target_shape_check.name: receivable_operation_target_shape_check
receivable_operation_target_shape_check.value:
(
        "receivable_operation"."action" like 'customer.%'
        and "receivable_operation"."receivable_id" is null
        and "receivable_operation"."payment_id" is null
      ) or (
        "receivable_operation"."action" in ('receivable.posted', 'receivable.voided')
        and "receivable_operation"."receivable_id" is not null
        and "receivable_operation"."payment_id" is null
      ) or (
        "receivable_operation"."action" in ('receivable.payment_applied', 'receivable.payment_reversed')
        and "receivable_operation"."receivable_id" is not null
        and "receivable_operation"."payment_id" is not null
      )

receivable_payment_reversal_shape_check.name: receivable_payment_reversal_shape_check
receivable_payment_reversal_shape_check.value:
("receivable_payment"."kind" = 'payment' and "receivable_payment"."reverses_payment_id" is null)
          or ("receivable_payment"."kind" = 'reversal' and "receivable_payment"."reverses_payment_id" is not null)

sale_description_length_check.name: sale_description_length_check
sale_description_length_check.value: "sale"."description" is null or char_length("sale"."description") between 1 and 240

sale_correction_replacement_check.name: sale_correction_replacement_check
sale_correction_replacement_check.value:
("sale_correction"."kind" = 'void' and "sale_correction"."replacement_sale_id" is null)
        or ("sale_correction"."kind" = 'replacement' and "sale_correction"."replacement_sale_id" is not null)
